items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs. Bears. Rapoport corroborated the full list including Hall.
items.why: Quad injury from Week 3; ruled out Friday.
items.implication: Full backfield opportunity shifts; Braelon Allen expected heavy snaps/carries vs soft Bears run D.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels officially out Sunday (elbow). Rapoport: Dan Quinn made it official Marcus Mariota starts again vs Colts.
items.why: Elbow dislocation recovery; not quite ready despite limited practice.
items.implication: Mariota starts; reduced dual-threat ceiling for WAS offense, potential checkdown/volume bump for pass-catchers.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on IR due to hamstring. Rapoport confirmed coach Kellen Moore announcement.
items.implication: Saints backfield opens; Kamara/Neal/Miller see expanded roles long-term.

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has 13.8% target share (vs 8.3% with Sampson healthy). On pace for 64 catches after 26 last year in 14 games.
items.why: 4-game sample elevated receiving role due to teammate absence.
items.implication: PPR upside elevated; viable RB flex/handcuff with pass-game work.

items.text: Justin Jefferson (ankle) missed practice Thursday second straight day; availability vs MIA uncertain after Week 3 sprain.
items.implication: Game-time risk; monitor Friday/Saturday; Addison beneficiary if out.

items.text: Rams get back Puka Nacua (hip/groin) as Eagles prepare without DeVonta Smith. Multiple reports Nacua full participant Thursday, McVay expects him to play vs PHI.
items.why: Full practice Thursday after limited Wed; coach expects return after missing Weeks 2-3.
items.implication: WR1 volume returns; Adams TD-dependent downgrade in shared targets.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes/red-zone for Nacua; reverse Adams beneficiary

items.text: Little optimism Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sources expect he won’t go.
items.why: Hamstring sidelined this week; low optimism per sources.
items.implication: WR targets free up in PHI; Wicks/Goedert potential bumps opposite Nacua return.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): Led all RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches. CLE allows 88+ yards to RBs every game; full workhorse with Dowdle out.
items.why: Elite recent usage + soft matchup + no competition.
items.implication: Top-10 RB play this week; start confidently.

items.text: Fresh ETR Rest of Season Top-150 live: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall. Other notables Parker Washington 22, Saquon 30.
items.why: Post-Week 3 usage and opportunity solidify elite RB status.
items.implication: Strong buy/hold; top-tier ROS asset in half-PPR.

items.text: Ravens Zay Flowers and Lamar Jackson upgraded to full participants (Flowers hamstring recovery solid).
items.why: Full practice Thursday after prior limitations.
items.implication: Both expected to play at full strength; no downgrade.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return. NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; Wilson 36% target share last time Mitchell sidelined. 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Teammate absence boosts target share + favorable matchup.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes; snaps to 42% Week 3, 13% third downs. SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor usage profile + brutal run defense matchup.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: Just 16% target share/34 ypg career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9/13 Penix games; TE37 utilization.
items.why: Historically low volume/efficiency with Penix; underperformance.
items.implication: TE streamer fade; London soaks targets.
items.conflict: Levitan notes similar low targets/aDOT underperformance
